response.scene_summary: The clip demonstrates a user uploading an image of a Pokémon card ('Tauros') to an 'Agent chat' interface. The system then processes the image, displaying a 'Run checklist' that progressively updates with checkmarks as various detection steps complete. The 'Active item' confidence updates from 0% to 62%, and the processed item appears in the 'Vault queue'.
key_observations: The UI starts with 'No active card' and '0% confidence'.
An image file named 'roboflow-tauros-real-card.jpg' is uploaded.
The 'Run checklist' items (e.g., 'Card detected', 'Edges visible', 'Blur check passed') sequentially receive green checkmarks.
The 'Active item' confidence updates to 62% by the end of the clip.
The 'Vault queue' updates to include the uploaded card with 'Needs human review' and 62% DING review.
